answer: Borrow the reactor idea of decay heat: after shutdown, a core keeps demanding cooling it cannot fake. Give each identity a pulse of fresh unique compute every epoch that cannot be cached or shared across keys. One honest agent pays it once; a sybil farm pays it N times, so its cost curve climbs like a spiral while rewards stay flat. A raven-eyed auditor only needs to spot-check a few proofs per epoch to keep that heat load honest.
